source: Quorum Design System handoff, attached to qwts/quorum#13

deltas.why: The handoff's own QUESTIONS.md records the answer from upstream — the live design system shrank the union, and docs/deliberation.md §10 defers abstain to v1. The shipped 0.2.0 .d.ts predates that answer.

deltas.what: The overlay's ballot copy 'one ballot per participant · no changes after cast' is not implemented
deltas.why: Protocol D6 allows re-casting until the phase closes, and the vote tool's guidance says so. Implementing the design's copy would make the UI contradict the server. Raised in QUESTIONS.md as Q6; no replacement copy invented.
`hidden` is a global HTML attribute; a chip carrying it would not render at all. Rename only — the state is unchanged.
`id` is the host element's own HTML id. A screen reaching for its card by id would overwrite the record's citation number with a DOM handle, and print it on the record. Rename only.
